data.exact_reserve_text: During 2023 we saw a decrease of claims incurred compared to 2022 which saw the impact of the war in Ukraine and exposure to Hurricane Ian.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reported exposure to Hurricane Ian in 2022 which contributed to elevated claims activity in that year and affected reserve outcomes in subsequent development periods.
The report cites the impact of the war in Ukraine on 2022 claims experience which contributed to higher claims in that period and influenced reserve movements.

named_events.loss_description: Report notes exposure to Hurricane Ian in 2022 impacting claims experience.
Report references impact of the war in Ukraine on 2022 claims experience.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 813.6m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development triangle, prioryear (2021 and earlier) development in 2023 amounted to a net adverse movement of approximately GBP 6.6m (about 0.8% of opening reserves), i.e. a small strengthening. The report highlights that 2022 experienced significant catastrophe and geopolitical-driven activity (notably Hurricane Ian and the war in Ukraine) which influenced claims emergence and prior year development; overall reserve movements were relatively modest in 2023.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was computed from the published GROSS claims development triangle (gross values in GBP 000). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was provided; therefore triangle extraction was used (confidence 0.8). The report includes RITC and exchange rate impacts in the claims reconciliation which can distort simple comparisons; RITC impact is shown separately in the reconciliation. There is no explicit verbatim sentence in the notes that quantifies a GROSS prioryear release/strengthening; the copied 'exact_reserve_text' describes claims incurred movements rather than a gross prior-year movement. No LOB-specific prior year reserve movements are disclosed, so lob_movements is left empty.
